transcript: My sister has been training for the marathon every day In two more weeks she will run the race at first She was too exhausted to run 10 kilometers and would end up walking halfway Her body could not yet keep up with her goal But she kept making steady effort and gradually learned how to control her breathing. Lately she has enough strength to finish the full 10 kilometers. I go out to the riverbank to watch her. In order to reach her goal, she runs every day. To have such a clear purpose is something bright and admirable. I am sure that on the race day she will cross the finish line with a smile On that day she will be not only a runner but also someone who has turned steady effort into real confidence

segments.text: My sister has been training for the marathon every day
In two more weeks she will run the race at first
She was too exhausted to run 10 kilometers and would end up walking halfway
Her body could not yet keep up with her goal
But she kept making steady effort and gradually learned how to control her breathing.
Lately she has enough strength to finish the full 10 kilometers.
I go out to the riverbank to watch her.
In order to reach her goal, she runs every day.
To have such a clear purpose is something bright and admirable.
I am sure that on the race day she will cross the finish line with a smile
On that day she will be not only a runner but also someone who has turned steady effort into real confidence
